Priya S: RCA published for the degraded model-serving memory spike. Link: <https://internal.redwood.com/rcas/2337601235|RCA - memory spike>. Summary in one line: allocator fragmentation during a partial rollout + insufficient eviction surface.
Evan R: reading, thanks. what's the immediate mitigation plan?
Priya S: short term: pin the previous runtime on affected pools and trigger a controlled drain of the new instances. owner: Tom H. medium: allocator patch + improved heap metrics by end of sprint. long: runtime-level mem compaction and better preflight checks for canaries.
Tom H: ack. I'll start drain in the next 30m and coordinate with ops for capacity buffer.
Nora M: adding automated alert to catch 75th-99th percentile mem growth, will also surface per-model contributors.
infra-bot: Preflight check started for pool: shard-2-east. ETA 3m.
ops-oncall: confirmed, holding 10% spare capacity in the region during drain. will monitor QPS drop.
Evan R: can we add a follow-up checkpoint in 7 days to review rollback criteria and residual error rate?
Priya S: yes — scheduled checkpoint Apr 2. please list any test cases you want included in the postmortem test harness.
Tom H: will add the drain logs and timeline to the RCA doc after I run it.
Priya S: thanks all. if you are assigned an action, mark it complete in the doc when done. Postmortem folder updated and contacts added.
